product_surface_cards.alt: Jini install and first useful output flow
product_surface_cards.title: Install once, then start with jini.
product_surface_cards.body: The surface should get you from install to a first useful artifact without teaching a command tree.
product_surface_cards.truth_note: Current example capture. No live checkout or signed desktop-release claim.

product_surface_cards.alt: Jini active work, ready items, and missing items view
product_surface_cards.title: Keep ready, missing, and next visible.
product_surface_cards.body: Jini should make the current work legible instead of forcing users to reconstruct state from chat and files.
product_surface_cards.truth_note: Current example capture. Session state and artifact posture only, not a public app-download claim.

product_surface_cards.alt: Jini metrics and route evidence surface
product_surface_cards.title: Show cost, route, and latency evidence.
product_surface_cards.body: The trust story should be inspectable through metrics and route evidence, not hidden behind provider jargon.
product_surface_cards.truth_note: Current example capture. Route evidence shown here is interface proof, not live paid-savings telemetry.

output_cards.alt: Jini turning meeting notes into a sendable follow-up
output_cards.title: Turn scattered notes into something you can send.
output_cards.body: Get a sendable follow-up, owners, and open questions without rebuilding the meeting later.
output_cards.truth_note: Example artifact from the public meeting-follow-up scenario.

output_cards.alt: Jini checking whether a plan is ready to hand off
output_cards.title: Check whether a plan is actually ready.
output_cards.body: See what is safe, what is missing, and what still blocks a real handoff.
output_cards.truth_note: Example artifact from the public spec-readiness scenario.

output_cards.alt: Jini preparing a recommendation memo from a vendor comparison
output_cards.title: Keep the reasoning attached to the recommendation.
output_cards.body: Get an output you can explain later instead of a conclusion you have to reconstruct from memory.
output_cards.truth_note: Example artifact from the public vendor-choice scenario.

output_cards.alt: Jini separating incident closure from follow-up work that still remains
output_cards.title: Separate the fix from the aftercare.
output_cards.body: Keep remaining risks, follow-up owners, and closure work visible instead of declaring the work done too early.
output_cards.truth_note: Example artifact from the public incident-closure scenario.
